note: Proposed by registrable domain on the issue perimeter, 2026-08-22 (slice 2.4, ADR-0007 §11a). To apply: add a top-level "decidedBy" with your name, edit or delete entries, then `kxrun apply-families --batch <file>`. Without decidedBy the file is refused - a family is an editorial fact and the record has to name who decided it. A correction later is a new decision, never an edit of this one. These assert nothing but that a document came from the domain it came from: one document, one host, no grouping claimed. They exist because a document with no family is unknown, and unknown never satisfies a two-independent-sources requirement (ADR-0007 §12). APPLIED 2026-08-23: the owner authorised these 155 specifically, on the ground that they assert nothing beyond the domain a document came from. The 39 in the review file, which do assert a grouping, were deliberately excluded and remain with the owner.
